jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: A role with Target Data Science & Engineering means helping develop and manage state-of-the-art predictive algorithms that use data at scale to automate and optimize decisions. You'll use expertise in machine learning, probability & statistics, deep learning, GenAI, NLP, or computer vision, implementing solutions with well-maintained, tested, documented code, and collaborating with Marketing, Supply Chain Optimization, Network Security and Personalization partners.
requirements: 4-year degree in a Quantitative discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or equivalent experience
Solid foundations in math and programming; strong fundamentals in Probability, Statistics, Linear Algebra
Strong hands-on programming in Python, SQL, Hadoop/Hive, ML engineering
Working knowledge of deep learning, computer vision, GenAI, ML
Strong analytical thinking and ability to communicate data-driven stories via visualizations and narratives

jobs.title: Sr Engineer - Managed Kubernetes
jobs.description: Managed Kubernetes provides the foundational container platform for deploying and operating applications across Target's data centers and public cloud. As Senior Engineer, you'll design, build, and operate reliable cloud-native platform capabilities, own Kubernetes platform components end-to-end, solve complex technical/operational problems independently, and help other engineers grow through technical guidance.
requirements: Deep Kubernetes and platform engineering expertise
Experience owning platform services through design, implementation, deployment and production operation
Ability to balance customer needs, reliability, security, maintainability and delivery constraints
Comfortable operating across public cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-premises environments

jobs.title: Director - Real Estate Counsel
jobs.description: The Real Estate Law team provides transactional support, legal advice and strategic direction on matters supporting Target's real estate strategy. As Director – Real Estate Counsel, you'll negotiate and draft real estate transactions (ground/building leases, purchase and sale agreements, easement and development agreements) supporting Target's store portfolio and growth, representing Target externally with developers, landlords and governmental authorities, and partnering with the paralegal team on title review and closings.
requirements: J.D. and active law license; substantial real estate transactional experience
Experience negotiating and drafting commercial real estate agreements
Ability to represent the company externally with developers, landlords, co-tenants and government authorities
Strong collaboration skills working with internal business partners and paralegal teams

jobs.title: Sr Cybersecurity Analyst (Cyber Threat Intelligence)
jobs.description: As a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you'll support identification, collection, analysis, production and dissemination of intelligence on cyber threats to Target — converting threat reporting, technical indicators and internal security context into insights that inform detection, response and risk prioritization. You'll analyze indicators of compromise, threat actor TTPs, malware behavior and campaign activity, applying frameworks like the Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT&CK, and partner with CSIRT, Reverse Engineering and Threat Management teams.
requirements: Experience as an all-source cyber threat intelligence analyst
Familiarity with structured analytic techniques and frameworks (Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, MITRE ATT&CK)
Strong analytic rigor, technical curiosity and sound judgment working independently
Ability to draft and deliver finished intelligence products and briefings

jobs.title: Account Manager, Roundel - Target Product Ads
jobs.description: Roundel is Target's advertising sell-side media business, built on first-party data and brand-safe environments. As Manager, Account Management, you'll develop a multi-channel, integrated marketing approach across digital platforms for Roundel clients, maintaining highly productive relationships with internal and external partners, and using strong communication skills to tell the story of Roundel's differentiators in the marketplace.
requirements: Client-facing account management experience in digital media/advertising
Strong communication and relationship-management skills
Ability to problem-solve tactically while seeing the bigger strategic picture
Curiosity about the digital advertising space and creative campaign thinking

jobs.title: Loyalty Marketing Analyst
jobs.description: As a Marketing Associate on Loyalty Member Engagement, you'll manage and oversee incentive and benefits marketing execution across owned and operated channels, influencing marketing strategy and bringing it to life through cross-functional execution management, assessing performance and informing future activations with an analytical skillset.
requirements: Four-year degree or equivalent experience
2-3 years of experience in marketing analytics, loyalty, or equivalent
Proficient in data analytics, with ability to analyze and recommend strategies from data
Strong written/verbal communication across cross-functional and vendor partners

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst
jobs.description: Join the Data Analytics team across Marketing, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Store Operations and Finance, turning data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches, design and deliver analytical and AI-driven solutions (including GenAI and agentic approaches), and work with large-scale datasets on platforms like GCP BigQuery, Spark, and SQL-based warehouses.
requirements: Strong experience translating ambiguous business problems into analytical approaches
Hands-on experience with BigQuery, Spark, SQL, and pipeline orchestration (e.g. Airflow)
Experience applying causal, predictive, and prescriptive analytics
Ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear recommendations for business stakeholders

jobs.title: Project Planner, Target Printing Services
jobs.description: Target Printing Services (TPS) drives internal partners' strategy (Marketing, Store Operations) through print and kitting projects. As Print Planner, you'll own estimating, production planning and ordering of materials, partnering with Project and Account Managers to translate approved project requirements into accurate, cost-effective production plans, balancing cost, efficiency, quality and timelines.
requirements: Experience in production planning, estimating, or print/manufacturing operations
Familiarity with estimating and planning tools (e.g. Monarch Estimating)
Strong vendor and materials coordination skills
Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple concurrent production plans

jobs.title: Sr Analyst, Domestic First Mile Transportation (Hybrid)
jobs.description: As Senior Analyst on the Domestic First Mile Transportation team, you'll play a critical role optimizing how product moves from vendors into Target's supply chain — leveraging data and operational insight to improve transportation performance, identify network optimization opportunities, and influence strategic decisions strengthening the inbound transportation network. Combines analytical problem solving, program management and relationship management across Transportation, Inventory, Distribution, Merchandising, Technology, Finance and carrier partners.
requirements: Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills
Experience with transportation, logistics or supply-chain network optimization
Program/relationship management across cross-functional and external carrier partners
Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Inventory Analyst Intern (Starting Summer 2027)
jobs.description: An entry-level internship giving a realistic preview of life as an Inventory Analyst — applying financial, analytical and communication skills to impact the bottom line while delivering products to guests. Interns manage a project from start to finish, present results to department leadership, and gain insight into negotiating and maintaining vendor relationships, with extensive training and development support.
requirements: Current cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong planning and organizational abilities
Exceptional leadership qualities and decision-making skills; strong communication

jobs.title: Guest Advocate (Cashier or Front of Store/Cart Attendant)
jobs.description: Advocates of guest experience who welcome, thank, and exceed service expectations — focusing on guest interaction, loyalty enrollment and store cleanliness, at checklanes, guest services, gift registry, pick-up and drive-up. Builds skills in communicating with guests, problem-solving and decision-making to resolve guest concerns, and promoting store benefits/services.
requirements: Comfortable greeting and interacting with guests in a fast-paced environment
Ability to adapt to different guest interactions and situations
Basic comfort with point-of-sale / checkout systems
Reliable availability for part-time retail scheduling

jobs.title: Specialty Sales — Style Consultant (Style, Tech, Beauty)
jobs.description: Style Consultants bring the energy of style to life through strong operations, guest experience and compelling visual merchandising. Responsibilities include driving sales via visual standards and signing, sorting and locating freight, setting visual presentations, maintaining product availability and a full floorpad, and remerchandising as product sells through.
requirements: Interest in retail merchandising, visual presentation, or fashion/beauty/tech categories
Comfort with physical tasks: sorting freight, stocking, setting displays
Basic retail business fundamentals (inventory, pricing/promotions awareness) a plus
Guest-first, team-oriented attitude

jobs.title: Specialty Sales Team Leader
jobs.description: Leads multiple businesses within Apparel & Accessories, Home, Baby, Core Beauty and Electronics, balancing team member expertise across departments. Builds skills in retail business fundamentals (sales trends, inventory management, pricing/promotions), workload planning to hit sales goals, and leading a team of hourly team members including interviewing, developing, coaching and retaining talent.
requirements: Prior experience leading or supervising a retail team
Retail business fundamentals: sales trends, inventory management, promotions strategy
Interviewing, coaching and talent-development skills
Ability to balance multiple departments/businesses at once

jobs.title: Target Security Specialist
jobs.description: Assets Protection teams keep guests, team and brand secure and lead through crisis events — protecting profitable sales by mitigating shortage risk and preventing/resolving theft and fraud. Responsibilities include intelligence-led security tactics, crisis response and de-escalation, operating video surveillance systems, and timely documentation of security incidents using case management systems.
requirements: Comfort with crisis response, safety and crowd-management situations
De-escalation skills and composure under pressure
Attention to detail for incident documentation
Ability to build relationships with store leaders and public safety officials

jobs.title: Executive Team Leader HR (Assistant Manager HR)
jobs.description: Leads a team of HR Experts and Team Leaders supporting the store's sales force, championing change and building diverse, inclusive talent strategies. Spends most of the day on the sales floor as a consultant to peers, creating and managing HR strategy and goals, reading financial reports, applying employment law knowledge, and coaching business leaders on growing their teams.
requirements: Experience managing HR strategy and goals, delivering results through a team
Knowledge of federal, state and local employment law
Recruiting, selecting and talent-management experience for hourly team members and leaders
Ability to read financial reporting and interpret data; coach/consult with senior business leaders

jobs.title: General Merchandise, Closing, Fulfillment (Fulfillment Expert)
jobs.description: Fulfillment Experts pick, prep, pack, sort and ship products safely and efficiently to deliver on guest digital orders (order pickup, drive up, ship to home). Work changes daily based on guest ordering patterns, using reporting systems to meet shifting digital demand while maintaining accuracy, timeliness and safety standards.
requirements: Comfort in a fast-changing, task-switching warehouse-style store environment
Basic systems literacy for order-management tools
Attention to accuracy and timeliness under demand swings
Ability to follow safety/food-safety procedures

jobs.title: Warehouse Operations (Warehouse Associate / Warehouse Worker)
jobs.payRange: $20.00 - $25.30 USD per hour depending on role
jobs.description: Warehouse Operations roles pack, load and ship items to stores and guests, ensuring accurate processing of merchandise and safely/efficiently handling freight and moving inventory throughout the distribution center. Includes safety training, basic math and label-reading tasks, and operating warehouse computer systems or handheld devices.
requirements: Able to lift and carry merchandise 35-60 lbs during a shift
Comfortable standing, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, bending and reaching during shifts
Basic math (counting, addition, subtraction) and label-reading accuracy
Able to operate computer systems or handheld scanners after training

jobs.title: Warehouse Worker - Food Distribution Center
jobs.description: Warehouse Workers at the food distribution center pack, load and ship items to stores and guests, working safely and efficiently to handle freight and move inventory, including at heights on mezzanines. Role includes training to safely operate powered equipment such as pallet riders, scissor lifts and forklifts.
requirements: Able to lift/carry merchandise 35-60 lbs and push utility carts up to 60 lbs
Comfortable working at heights (up to 40 ft on a mezzanine where applicable)
Willingness to be trained on and operate powered equipment (forklift, pallet rider, scissor lift)
Good written and oral communication skills

jobs.title: Senior Target Security Specialist - Flow Center
jobs.description: Leads a physical security and safety culture at a Target supply-chain facility through best practices and program management. Executes strategic routines to identify, prevent and investigate theft and shortage leveraging technology, stores and supply-chain partnerships, and reporting/security tactics; operates Target-owned vehicles for yard and perimeter patrol.
requirements: Experience in physical security, loss prevention, or asset protection
Comfortable leading investigative/patrol routines independently
Valid driver's license for yard/perimeter vehicle patrol
Strong cross-team partnership skills (stores, supply chain, corporate security)

jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer
jobs.description: Target's Advanced AI team builds end-to-end AI/ML systems creating business value across the enterprise, powered by LLMs, classical ML, or deep learning, designed as scalable, production-grade applications including agentic architectures. As Senior AI Engineer, you'll build, deploy and maintain AI/ML applications supporting automation, insight and action across core business workflows, writing maintainable code, building APIs/services, and supporting deployment and monitoring.
requirements: Hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade AI/ML applications
Experience with LLM-based or agentic system architectures
Strong software engineering fundamentals: testing, APIs, deployment, monitoring
Ability to turn ambiguous business problems into practical technical solutions

jobs.title: Warehouse Operations - $1,000 Sign-On Bonus (Warehouse Associate / Worker)
jobs.description: Warehouse Operations roles pack, load and ship items to stores and guests, safely and efficiently handling freight and moving inventory through the distribution center, with a $1,000 sign-on bonus for seasonal and permanent positions hired in the current window.
requirements: Able to lift and carry merchandise 35-60 lbs during a shift
Comfortable with varied shift schedules (day/evening/overnight)
Basic math and label-reading accuracy
Team-oriented, safety-first attitude in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Asset Protection Associate
jobs.category: Stores and Clubs : Security and Asset Protection
jobs.description: This role focuses on the safety and security of associates, customers, and merchandise at a Neighborhood Market location, including investigating issues and working to solve complex problems. requirements: Smile, greet, and thank customers with a positive attitude
Stand for long periods of time while checking out customers quickly and accurately
Keep your area clean and presentable
Answer customer questions and help them with their needs

jobs.title: Cart Attendant

jobs.description: Cart Attendants ensure customers have a great first and last impression of the store by gathering carts from the parking lot, operating equipment to move carts from the lot into the store, and maintaining the sanitation and cleanliness of the shopping carts. The role requires a positive attitude in all weather conditions, since the pace can be intense during evenings, weekends, and holiday seasons. Gather carts from the parking lot
Operate equipment to move carts from the parking lot to inside the store
Clean restrooms, salesfloor, and parking lot as needed
Have a positive attitude in all weather conditions

jobs.title: Checkout Team Associate
jobs.category: Stores and Clubs : Cashier, Front-End and Membership Services
jobs.description: Front End Checkout associates run the registers at a WM Supercenter: they smile, greet and thank customers, ring up items, process payments, and keep a positive attitude. This role may require standing for long periods of time and juggling several tasks quickly, especially during evenings, weekends, and holiday seasons. Associates are expected to be ambassadors of Walmart and ready to help with customer questions and needs.
requirements: Smile, greet, and thank customers with a positive attitude
Stand for long periods of time while checking out customers quickly and accurately
Scan items, explain pricing, bag items properly, and count cash back
Keep your area clean and presentable
Answer customer questions and help them with their needs

jobs.title: Stocking Team Supervisor
jobs.category: Stores and Clubs : General Merchandise, Stocking and Unloading
jobs.description: Stocking associates are focused on unloading trucks and stocking new freight at a WM Supercenter, spending the majority of their time in the backroom. The role requires the ability to lift heavy objects in excess of 50 pounds, and the ability to operate heavy machinery such as forklifts may also be necessary. This fast-paced, physically demanding job ranges from unloading trucks in the summer to filling the ice cream freezer.
requirements: Unload trucks
Sort products in the backroom
Stock products on shelves
Ensure aisles are neat and area is clean
Engage vendors and drivers with a positive attitude
Greet customers and answer their questions

jobs.title: Deli/Bakery Team Associate
jobs.category: Stores and Clubs : Food and Grocery
jobs.description: The main priority of Deli/Bakery associates is to prepare quality products for customers at a WM Supercenter, engaging with customers at the service counter and moving incoming merchandise out to the salesfloor. Cleaning and maintaining proper food safety standards are critical to the team's success. Associates help customers celebrate special moments in the bakery and serve on the frontlines of customer service in the deli.
requirements: Prepare quality deli and bakery products for customers
Engage with customers at the service counter
Move incoming merchandise out to the salesfloor
Maintain detailed cleaning of shelves and department, checking and maintaining temperature control
Verify dates and dispose of lesser-quality food products

jobs.title: Clinical Services Pharmacy Technician - Sam's Club
jobs.description: This role provides member service by identifying member needs, assisting with purchasing decisions, and promoting Sam's Club total healthcare solutions. It involves assisting with processing prescription and OTC orders, stocking and securing pharmacy supplies, entering prescription information, and completing required documentation. The associate also provides expanded comprehensive patient care by administering clinical service programs such as immunizations and point-of-care testing, in compliance with State Board of Pharmacy statutes and regulations.
requirements: Assist with processing prescription and OTC orders and purchases
Stock and secure pharmacy supplies and merchandise
Enter prescription information and maintain required documentation
Administer clinical service programs (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing) per state pharmacy board regulations
Collaborate with healthcare professionals to ensure accurate and timely dispensation of medications
Monitor stock levels and assist in inventory management

jobs.title: Truck Driver OTR - Regional - Reno/Sparks, NV (Western US Regional Overnight)
jobs.description: Regional truck drivers plan their day, set priorities, and work with their team to keep freight moving safely and on time, running optimized routes while following traffic laws and local restrictions. Drivers handle all required paperwork and electronic logs accurately and follow DOT, state, and company guidelines, and safely operate and inspect their tractor-trailer before, during, and after each trip. Walmart advertises that regional drivers on this route can earn up to $110,000 in their first year, with weekly home time and consecutive days off every week.
requirements: Interstate (Class A) Commercial Driver's License with Hazmat endorsement (or will obtain within 120 days of hire)
Minimum of 30 months (2.5 years) experience in a full-time Class A tractor/trailer driving position in the previous 3 years
No more than two moving violations in the last three years operating a personal or commercial motor vehicle
No preventable accidents in the last three years, and no preventable DOT recordable accidents in the last ten years
No preventable accident resulting in a fatality or catastrophic injury in driving history
Must currently live within 250 miles of the assigned facility or be willing to relocate within 90 days of hire

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.description: As a member of the Maintenance team at an eCommerce Warehouse Logistics distribution center, this associate is responsible for repairs and preventative maintenance on distribution center equipment and the building, utilizing a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to record work history, identify parts usage, and track warranties. Career opportunities in this family include Battery Changer, Custodial, Licensed Electrician, Maintenance Technician, Multi-Skilled Technician, and Maintenance Planner roles. Attention to detail and focus on safety are critical to the role.
requirements: Maintain, repair, and conduct preventative maintenance on material handling and building equipment safely and efficiently
Read and understand technical drawings (blueprints, electronic/mechanical schematics) to repair and maintain equipment
Troubleshoot complex equipment problems where the repair is not immediately visible or obvious
Utilize a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to record workorders, asset/labor history, and inventory usage
Coursework or certification in electronic technology plus 2 years of industrial maintenance experience (or 3 years of equivalent experience) troubleshooting and repairing automated equipment
Operate material handling equipment, battery equipment, moving machinery, and other powered equipment

jobs.title: General Production Associate, Manufacturing
jobs.category: Supply Chain and Transportation : Supply Chain and Transportation Operations
jobs.description: At this Walmart meat processing plant, the General Production Associate operates and monitors production equipment by following standard operating procedures and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Document and record production and quality information accurately
Operate and troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and systems using automated and manual controls
Adhere to all safety procedures and guidelines, including use of personal protective equipment
Report hazards, near misses, injuries, or accidents and participate in safety trainings and drills
Maintain cleanliness in work areas to prevent accidents and support continuous improvement of safety protocols

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills working with complex financial and tax data
Experience leveraging technology, automation, and data analytics to improve tax accounting processes and controls
